answer.text: The number-plate light is an LED unit.
If it fails, the manual says the whole tail lamp and number-plate light assembly should be replaced, not just a bulb.
Contact a Royal Enfield Authorised Dealer or Service Centre to have it replaced.

policy.text: Replace the whole tail lamp and number-plate light assembly if it fails.
Have the replacement done by a Royal Enfield Authorised Dealer or Service Centre.
Use bulbs and electrical parts of the specified rating only.

watchouts.text: Using bulbs or electrical parts with a rating other than the specified one can cause overloading, erratic behaviour or early failure of the electrical system.
Fitting parts that Royal Enfield has not approved can seriously affect the vehicle's performance and will void the warranty.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not give a part number, bulb type or wattage for the number-plate light, so I cannot say which bulb to buy.
The 0.31 W figure in the manual is for the tail lamp, not the number-plate light.
Confirm the correct part with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre before buying anything.

watchout_review.reason: Warns against bulbs of a rating other than specified, which bears on buying a bulb.
